🔧﻿​​​​​​​​​‌​​​​​‌‍​​​​​​​​​‌‌​‌‌​​‍​​​​​​​​​​‌​‌‌​‌‍​​​​​​​​​‌​​​​​‌‍​​​​​​​​​‌‌​‌​​​‍​​​​​​​​​‌‌​​​​‌‍​​​​​​​​​‌‌​​‌​​‍﻿ Use 'ākhira (the other/further existence)' not 'hereafter.' The ākhira is qualitatively OTHER, not merely temporally later.
